$comment: Mutation configuration. Scope it to the domain: mutating adapters and framework glue produces survivors nobody can act on, and a score nobody trusts gets ignored. Run the matching tool for the stack: Stryker (TS/JS), mutmut or cosmic-ray (Python), PIT (Java/Kotlin), cargo-mutants (Rust), go-mutesting (Go).
ratchet: Record the score in CI. The threshold only moves up; lowering it is a review comment, not a fix.
